system.description:
An open-top grav vehicle that essentially functions similar to a floating car. Four passengers and four tons of cargo.

Distance of operation: 3,000km. Weight 4T, TL 9, speed band 4, cost 600,000cr.

Damage locations (book): Interior 2, Speed 4, Hull 2. The book gives no Handling value; Handling is set to the Hull value.

Gravcraft are anti-gravity vehicles that hover up to 6 metres above a surface.

  • Grav: This vehicle is operated using the Drive (Grav) Skill.
  • Open: In the case of any interior hit, roll 1D; a result of 2+ results in the occupants or cargo being hit instead of the system.
  • Ascend: This grav vehicle isn't limited by the 6m ceiling of height above a surface, but takes 1 hour per 1km to move vertically. Ascend grav vehicles effectively have VTOL.

Cargo: For every one occupant slot, 50kg of cargo can be carried instead. Weapons can be added to a vehicle after purchase, but civilian vehicles are unarmed by default. Cruising speed: vehicles with speed band 3+ have a cruising speed equal to one speed band less than top speed (p.46).

Source: p.47.

A high speed grav vehicle designed for one driver and enough space for one passenger or up to 100kg cargo.

Distance of operation: 1,000km. Weight 1T, TL 11, speed band 8, cost 100,000cr.

Damage locations (book): Interior 1, Speed 8, Hull 1. The book gives no Handling value; Handling is set to the Hull value.

Occupants 2 (driver and passenger); the passenger slot can carry up to 100kg cargo instead, so the cargo field is 0.

A larger but enclosed and armoured air-raft similar to an ATV. 16 passengers.

Distance of operation: 3,000km. Weight 8T, TL 9, speed band 3, cost 1Mcr.

Damage locations (book): Interior 3, Speed 3, Hull 3, Weapon 1, Armour 3. The book gives no Handling value; Handling is set to the Hull value.

The stat line has Weapon 1, but the book does not say which weapon is mounted, so no weapon item is embedded.

  • Military: This vehicle is only available at military-owned locations and is available for military personnel to use.
